body: Building roadmap items 1-2 from docs/reference-harness-gap-inventory.md section U: (1) provider-failure honesty and the provider-death path - evidence delivery no longer requires retryable=true, fallback texts name the canonical code and honor retryability, frontend Try again honors retryable; (2) identity context injection - user-stated identity facts (place/timezone/name) as guaranteed injected items with provenance, loaded at boot and refreshed on statement.
